comparator.sourceNotes: The official programme is a three-year, 180-EC bachelor offered in parallel English and Dutch tracks. The normalized registry target records Dutch, but the current public programme explicitly permits either full-programme language track; the English track is selected to align the comparison language without changing academic content. The published schemes define 60 EC per year: a first-year foundation in life sciences, mathematics, statistics, computing and integrated projects; advanced data science, machine learning and responsible AI in year 2; and 30 EC free choice plus a 30-EC final-project cluster in year 3.

notes.text: WUR prescribes dedicated life-science integration, domain projects, responsible AI and a 30-EC final challenge-project cluster. UCR can construct strong computational, environmental and innovation pathways, but it does not reproduce that fixed domain-integrated sequence. The alternatives are defensible liberal-arts data-science pathways, not structural equivalence.
